messages.author: a850b849a51d3d6a
messages.subject: featureCounts: input-files.c:5354: SAM_pairer_run: Assertion `1 != corrected_run' failed.
parts:
Hello all,

I have 384 smartseq libraries profiled with Star. I then used featureCounts (subread 1.6.0-Linux-x86_64) to count genes. All excpt one library failed with this error:

featureCounts: input-files.c:5354: SAM_pairer_run: Assertion `1 != corrected_run' failed.


Some parameters:

-p -t exon -g gene_id -F GTF -a genes.gtf



I really don't know what causes the problem and how to fix it. Thank you very much for your help!

Best,
Jerry

messages.author: 6569f7247d312021

parts: Hi Jerry, could you please share the bam file that failed so that we can have a close look? Thanks, Wei

messages.author: dc97c9f21d982e2c
messages.subject: Re: featureCounts: input-files.c:5354: SAM_pairer_run: Assertion `1 != corrected_run' failed.
parts:
Hello, I've recently encountered this same error for a small number of files when running featureCounts (subread 1.6.1) on a large number of bams:

featureCounts: input-files.c:5381: SAM_pairer_run: Assertion `1 != corrected_run' failed.

The command was:
featureCounts --tmpDir /tmp -p -t exon -g transcript_id -T 1 -s 0 -M -O -d 40 -D 1000 -Q 1 -a $ANNOT -o $OUTPUT $BAMFILE

I'd be happy to share one of the bam files that resulted in this error, if you like.

messages.author: 6569f7247d312021
messages.subject: Re: featureCounts: input-files.c:5354: SAM_pairer_run: Assertion `1 != corrected_run' failed.
parts:
Yes it would be great if you can share the bam files. Could you please share the annotation file you used as well?

Best

Wei

messages.author: dc97c9f21d982e2c
messages.subject: Re: featureCounts: input-files.c:5354: SAM_pairer_run: Assertion `1 != corrected_run' failed.
parts:
Certainly.

Here's one of two bam files which failed with this error: https://portal.gdc.cancer.gov/legacy-archive/files/6a384274-0c65-45ff-ae60-c6b22634a831
It can be downloaded together with its index file using:
curl --remote-name --remote-header-name "https://api.gdc.cancer.gov/legacy/data/6a384274-0c65-45ff-ae60-c6b22634a831?related_files=true"

The annotation file was human release 90:
ftp://ftp.ensembl.org/pub/release-90/gtf/homo_sapiens/Homo_sapiens.GRCh38.90.gtf.gz

Thank you for your help.

messages.author: d25b9c7f2fe26841
messages.subject: Re: featureCounts: input-files.c:5354: SAM_pairer_run: Assertion `1 != corrected_run' failed.
parts: I met the exactly same problem today: when I used featureCounts from the latest 1.6.1 version to count 384 BAM files, the program abnormally exited at the 307th file. Then I ran featureCounts on that particular SAM file where the error was met for multiple times by using different thread numbers, but this error popped up in a seemingly random way, meaning that the same thread number may or may not product such an error. Then I re-ran the featureCounts for the whole SAM files again and unfortunately ran into this same error at the same SAM file again. I don't know what to do now. Please help! Many thanks!

Thanks for sending the data. We have fixed this in a new release we made today (1.6.2).

Best regards,
